resharper_indent_wrapped_function_names #

Indent a wrapped function name. Inert: the oracle returns the file unchanged at both values — on a wrapped call chain, a wrapped qualified name and a split declaration, alone and paired with wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls, align_multiline_calls_chain, outdent_dots and continuous_line_indent. The C#-prefixed spelling is equally inert.

resharper_wrap_before_colon #

A break around a : lands before it. Inert in both spellings, while wrap_before_extends_colon = true in the same run moves a base list's : onto its own line.
